notes.title: Version Update Notification
notes.notes:
Ver 1.30
- Added Hard stages (unlocked upon clearing normal)
- Added achievements related to Hard difficulty

notes.title: Bug Fix (2018/11/06)
notes.notes: Fixed translation, achievements, and stage 1-4 arrow.

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
The translating is finished and we are now in the process of inserting the translated text into the game.
We are also planning on implementing (Steam) Achievements and Trading Cards!
If everything goes as planned we intend to release the game early next month (November 2018). In the meantime, we ask for your patience.
